messages.subject: recover css of older shinydashboard version
parts:
In an effort to get my local package versions matching the versions on shinyserver, I updated to the latest version of shinydashboard.

It doesn't look as pretty for me anymore. (see attached before and after)

How can I recover the older style sheets.

Attempt 1.

I tried to just install the older version of shinydashboard, but this attempt failed, I'm not sure if I have the repos correct.

library(devtools)

install_version("shinydashboard",
+ version="0.2.3",
+ repos="http://rstudio.github.io/shinydashboard/")

Attempt 2.

I could update the css of the latest version of shinydashboard to be like the old, I'm not sure 100% how. Where is the complete style sheet I would need to change, how would I specify the original settings, I recall it is a theme AdminLTE (??)

I was trying to just swicth the black off following this post 

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/29583375/how-do-i-change-the-background-color-on-a-shiny-dashboard-in-r


Thanks!
Mike

Hi

Perhaps you can try this

   }"))), ...



(Cfr : https://github.com/rstudio/shinydashboard/blob/master/inst/AdminLTE/_all-skins.css)

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: recover css of older shinydashboard version
parts:
The install_version function from devtools only install versions that have been released to CRAN. Those versions are listed here:
  http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/shinydashboard/

To install an old version that was only in the development repository, you need to use install_github.
The commit that changed to 0.2.3 was 0c30d0, which you can install with:
  devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinydashboard@0c30d0")

But I'd suggest not fixing yourself to an old version, because it won't be supported in the future.

-Winston
